summary: Bio-Techne filed an 8-K updating its pending merger with Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany and EMD Holdings NewCo, Inc., under which Merger Sub will merge into Bio-Techne, leaving it a wholly-owned Merck subsidiary. The merger agreement was signed June 25, 2026; a definitive proxy was filed August 20, 2026, with the special meeting set for September 23, 2026. A Minnesota suit, Garfield v. Baumgartner, plus demand letters challenge proxy disclosures and seek to enjoin the vote; Bio-Techne calls claims meritless but is voluntarily supplementing disclosures. Watch vote timing, injunction risk, and any revised deal terms.
